capabilities: Bandit OPE/learning and logged bandit data tools
limitation: Contextual bandits do not represent multi-period banking carryover
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Context, logged action/reward, logging probability and target action distribution, including declared slate/position semantics.
scientific_qualification.output: One-step policy value or contextual-bandit policy.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Bandit exchangeability/support and correct logging probabilities; slate models need their own reward/propensity factorization.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Do not route multi-period banking carryover to a contextual-bandit value. Preserve action/position conventions and evaluate learned policies on independent or appropriately split data.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Recover a one-step finite contextual value, then build a two-step carryover example showing that one-step reward can reverse the preferred policy.

evidence.finding: Bandit modules and supported standard/slate/continuous-action OPE families.
